title: Assistant very slow this evening

acceptableCauses.mechanism: The LLM provider started rejecting our calls with 429 (quota exceeded: requests per minute, limit=1500); the orchestrator retries with backoff, so answers take 20 s+ and some fail.

partialCredit.reason: Right dependency, but misses that it is quota throttling.

requiredEvidence.description: 429 quota errors from the LLM provider

keyCounterevidence: The 429s began at ~20:05 IST, before the 20:12 IST prompt deploy; tokens per turn rose only ~12% after it.
redHerrings: past incident: prompt template latency regression
